messages:
Alex: Heads-up — we found a token rotation edge-case causing sporadic 401s in auth under burst traffic. It's small but user-impacting; request a hotfix during the launch freeze. Plan: pin runtime image, canary in prod, then quick cutover.
Maria: PM confirmed this qualifies as a safety hotfix. Legal/Compliance are ok with the change during the freeze. :+1:
Deploy Bot: @Alex created deploy request #D-8742 for service=auth, branch=hotfix/token-rotation. Canary policy: 1 -> 50 -> 100.
Jen: No model changes, right? We must avoid changing any model or quantization during freeze.
Alex: Correct — no model changes. Only config + pin runtime tag to r-inference:v2026.03.07-hotfix.
Sam: I'll run the pin and start canary. Pin command: `./deploy pin --service auth --tag r-inference:v2026.03.07-hotfix --env prod-canary`
Sam: Smoke script running: `scripts/smoke/auth_smoke.sh` -> hitting /v1/session rotate loop x10.
Maria: Add clear rollback criteria: if p95 latency > 250ms or error-rate bump > 0.5% in 10 minutes, rollback immediately.
Alex: Agreed. Rollback playbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/rollback-auth (follow steps 1-3 for emergency rollback).
Deploy Bot: Canary metrics: errors 0.08%, p95=210ms, throughput stable. Promoting to 50% traffic.
Jen: Watch KV cache hit rate and CPU on gpusrv-2 — we saw regressions at 50% last time.
Sam: Observability dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/dashboards/auth-hotfix-canary -> live.
Alex: After 10m at 50% with green metrics we cutover. Need approvals from @Maria and @Jen to proceed to 100%.
Maria: Approving for prod cutover.
Jen: Approving. :rocket:
Deploy Bot: Production deploy to 100% traffic started. Post-deploy smoke tests queued.
Deploy Bot: Production deploy complete. All post-deploy checks passed.
Sam: Added release-note draft: "auth: fix token rotation edge-case causing intermittent 401s; pinned runtime to r-inference:v2026.03.07-hotfix; canary and rollback plan executed"
Alex: Leaving a freeze-exception note in #eng-releases: hotfix during freeze, exception expires in 60m unless we escalate. Monitoring for 1h. :eyes:
Maria: I'll hand off monitoring to oncall after 30m. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.
Jen: Nice and clean. Closing my watch in 45m unless something pops up.
Alex: Closing thread after 1h if all green.
